doctor.name: Rich Nehring
doctor.bio: Dr. Rich is a certified pediatric dentist who has been calling Great Falls home since 2019. After graduating from the Indiana University School of Dentistry in 2012, he spent five years as a general dentist before following his passion for children's care through a specialized two-year residency with NYU Langone Health. Having served as chief resident at Shriners Children’s Hospital, he brings expert-level skill to every visit. Dr. Rich is known for his 'big kid at heart' philosophy, often using magic tricks and jokes to ensure every child leaves with a smile.

reviews.name: Amanda K.
reviews.text: Dr. Rich is incredible with kids! The magic tricks and jokes totally distracted my son from his cleaning. Best pediatric experience in Great Falls.

reviews.name: Marcus L.
reviews.text: The office is a dream for parents. Tablets, toys, and murals make it so easy to get the kids through the door without any tears.

reviews.name: Sarah J.
reviews.text: Finally found a place that understands special needs dentistry. Dr. Rich and his team were so patient and used very kid-friendly language.

reviews.name: Tyson R.
reviews.text: Highly recommend the sedation options for anxious kids. My daughter was totally at ease, and the toy machine at the end was a huge hit!

reviews.name: Elena W.
reviews.text: The new office on 9th St is beautiful and welcoming. The staff was so helpful with our insurance questions and made the first visit easy.

reviews.name: Brian P.
reviews.text: Dr. Rich clearly loves what he does. It's rare to find a dentist who can provide such high-level care while keeping things fun for toddlers.
